title: Jawa
description: Hidden behind their homespun robes and glowing eyes, Jawas were known to scavenge, scrap, and steal anything of value they could get their hands on. Some Jawas found themselves in league with Peli Motto in Mos Eisley, stealing parts off of speeders and other valuables at her behest as part of a vaguely criminal racket to get her the parts she needed for her own pet projects.
